title: Composed majority probability formula
statement:
For every natural number $m$ and every real $p$ with $0<p<1$, the biased minus-probability polynomial of the composed majority on $2+(2m+1)$ coordinates satisfies
\[
P_{\mathrm{comp}}(p)=p^2+2p(1-p)P_{\mathrm{maj}}(p),
\]
where $P_{\mathrm{comp}}$ denotes that polynomial for the composed majority and $P_{\mathrm{maj}}$ denotes it for majority on $2m+1$ coordinates.
